fact: The Université Amadou Mahtar Mbow in Diamniadio inaugurated its UniPod innovation pole, which will host the Timbuktoo EdTech hub, an incubator for African startups, and launched the Senegal Digital Factory programme.
title: Diamniadio – Senegal Digital Factory : L'Uam accueille le 1er Pôle universitaire d'innovation et de technologie
